name: Do I need a permit for major plumbing or electrical work in Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for major plumbing or electrical work in Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for major plumbing and electrical work in Oakland, you typically need permits to ensure the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. Examples of work requiring permits include new installations, extensive renovations, electrical panel upgrades, and significant pipe replacements. Your contractor should be able to advise you on specific permit requirements and handle the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, major plumbing and electrical work in Oakland usually requires permits to ensure code compliance and safety.
